items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Durante was in the show with us in Ziegfeld. ... They're our friends, we worked together.

ctx.x: He took a whole big table and sit it in the alley. The women were drinking champagne, there was some scotch. And I was telling them about New York. New York is jumping. He said, don't say no more, I got to get back there. But he was a rising star there, he couldn't -- one time he was making this Spanish picture. You know, he was a hell of a dancer, too. Man, I was on the set. My feet was killing me and he was doing a Spanish thing, had them soft Spanish slippers, so I went over to his dressing room. I said, "man,…

He says, 'man, can you imagine I get all this money for hugging these people. Sonny, did you ever think it would end up like this?' He was a big star and him and Jimmy Durante, and all them. They're our friends, we worked together.
